test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'JUNO' is written as '1356' and 'HATE' is written as '8125'. How will 'TOWER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'JUNO' is written as '1356',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37873317480da386388c278c013e2c7e3a9dfca2f1047253a638b3a04e3f9b8b.png] 

'HATE' is written as '8125',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eada03a6006179815f142e93fac056cd38bb3e1f8e8649f23cf396dc4e887470.png] 

Similarly, for '**TOWER**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/955fff304428118c0136e33218fc15d368fbe1ebbc2f668e683e27c30892ee05.png] 

So, '**TOWER**' will be written as '**26559**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
